activities.title: Guided horse ride through rice fields to the beach
activities.overview: A guided ride out through the rice fields to the beach. Our grooms come with you the whole way, on foot, so this is a relaxed, well supported ride even if you've never been on a horse before.

goodToKnow.label: Weight
goodToKnow.value: Max 75kg per rider with clothes on. Max 2 riders over 70kg. Riders are weighed at the stables.

included: Staff guiding on foot the whole way
Photos taken on your phone by our team

images.alt: Horse and rider on the beach with rice fields behind, Salty Cowboy Bali

activities.cardDesc: A relaxed guided ride along the beach and through rice fields.

activities.title: Two-hour horse ride with photo stops, village to beach
activities.overview: Our longest ride, with more stops for photos through the village, beach and rice fields. Grooms take you to the best spots along the way. Golden hour is ideal if you can book it.

goodToKnow.label: Weight
goodToKnow.value: Max 75kg per rider with clothes on. Max 2 riders over 70kg. Riders are weighed at the stables.

included: Staff guiding on foot the whole way
Photos taken on your phone by our team

images.alt: Rider on a horse pausing for a photo on the way to the beach

activities.cardDesc: Our longest ride, with plenty of stops for photos along the way.

activities.title: Beach and rice field photoshoot with a groomed horse
activities.overview: A static shoot for fashion, pre-wedding or personal sessions, along a 900m route through the rice fields to the beach. Time starts when you leave the stables. Out of respect for local culture, please no swimwear. Share your outfit plans with Simone beforehand.

goodToKnow.label: Experience
goodToKnow.value: No riding experience needed, the horse stays walking

included: Staff to help and assist you
The 900m walk through the village and along the rice fields to the beach

activities.title: Horse grooming class with the stable manager
activities.overview: Learn the finer art of grooming, wet or dry, with tips for Bali's warm, humid climate, taught by the stable manager. There's time for questions along the way.

activities.cardDesc: Learn wet or dry grooming from the stable manager.

activities.title: Join Up: natural horsemanship lesson, no riding
activities.overview: An introduction to natural horsemanship. Learn to "join up" a horse so it chooses to stay with you. Hands-on, grounded, and entirely off the saddle.

images.alt: Trainer working with a horse in a Join Up natural horsemanship lesson

activities.cardDesc: A hands-on lesson in natural horsemanship, learning to earn a horse's trust.

activities.title: Leadership and trust clinic with horses, for groups
activities.overview: A hands-on session in leadership, communication and trust, taught through the horse. Working at liberty in the round pen, your group learns to read body language, hold presence and earn cooperation without force, the same skills you'd use in any team setting. Popular with women's groups, business teams, and friend groups that ride.

goodToKnow.label: Group size
goodToKnow.value: 3 to 6 people, flat price per session, not per person

images.alt: Group leadership and trust clinic with horses

activities.cardDesc: A group session in leadership and trust, built through the horse.

activities.title: 3-day Horse Whisperer course for two
activities.basis: for the full course, up to 2 people
activities.overview: A 3-day, 10-hour course spread over Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Two sessions build the basics, then a closing session brings it together, including 2 hours of grooming or another related activity. Open to all levels, no experience needed. This course is for two people, so bring a friend.

goodToKnow.label: Group size
goodToKnow.value: Max 2 people, one course booking per week

included: 2 hours of grooming or another related activity
notIncluded: Riding. This course is groundwork, not ridden work

images.alt: Horse Whisperer course participants working with a horse

activities.cardDesc: A 3-day groundwork course for two, open to all levels.
